definitions.explanation: A person of outstanding ability in a particular skill or art—especially performing arts, sports, board games, or crafts. Conveys real admiration; not used casually.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名手|めいしゅ}だ。
examples.english: He is a master of the piano.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名手|めいしゅ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: He is known as a master of shogi.

examples.japanese: ⟦{守備|しゅび}→守備：15509_shubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名手|めいしゅ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: Teams with many players called defensive masters are strong.

notes:
Compound of {名|めい} (renowned, distinguished) + {手|しゅ} (hand, here meaning a person with a skilled hand). Often paired with the domain of skill: ⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名手|めいしゅ}, ⟦{弓|ゆみ}→弓：08430_yumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名手|めいしゅ}, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名手|めいしゅ}{揃|ぞろ}い: full of masters
- {名手|めいしゅ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名手|めいしゅ}: master among masters
- ⟦{弓|ゆみ}→弓：08430_yumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名手|めいしゅ}: master archer
- ⟦{守備|しゅび}→守備：15509_shubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名手|めいしゅ}: defensive virtuoso (sports)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{達人|たつじん}→達人：14378_tatsujin⟧: master; expert — broader, includes everyday domains; less performance-oriented
- ⟦{名人|めいじん}→名人：03753_meijin⟧: master; champion — often used for board game titles (⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧ ⟦{名人|めいじん}→名人：03753_meijin⟧)
- ⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: skilled person — everyday and much weaker praise
